The following events took place in '''3641 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi strike team (capture of the Sith Emperor)|strike team]] led by Jedi Master [[Tol Braga]] attempts to [[Mission to the Emperor's Fortress|capture]] the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] aboard his [[Emperor's Fortress|space station]], but are defeated and turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]].<ref name="TOR:Descent" />
*[[Darth Baras]]' [[Plan Zero]] was implemented with the help of his [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]], which combined with the recent conflicts ignited the fires of war across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TOR:DoW">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Declaration of War|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
*Thanks to Baras' machinations, his student was successful in the assassination of Baras' former master [[Darth Vengean]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], allowing Baras to take Vengean's place on the [[Dark Council]].<ref name="TOR:PP">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Power Play|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>
*Midway through the year, the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] officially collapsed. After eleven years, the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] ended, leading to the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
*The Sith Empire [[Invasion of Belsavis|invaded]] the prison world of [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] and released the [[Dread Masters]].<ref name="TOR:TitF">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Terror in the Flesh|Belsavis}}</ref>
